subject: Workplace Skills
title: Creating a Feedback Culture
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Creating a Feedback Culture.

hook.text: Teams that exchange feedback weekly outperform those that wait for reviews by 14%, per Gallup.

buildup.text: Most people avoid giving feedback because they fear the reaction. The less it happens, the scarier it gets.

discovery.text: Normalize feedback by asking for it first. 'What's one thing I could do better this week?' models openness.

twist.text: How you react to feedback determines how much you'll receive. React poorly once and the flow stops forever.

climax.text: Thank people publicly for giving you feedback. It signals safety to the whole team.

punchline.text: Want more feedback? Reward the ones who give it.

quiz.question: What's the best way to build a feedback culture on a team?
options: Make feedback mandatory through formal processes
Model openness by asking for feedback first and reacting well
Hire only people who are comfortable with confrontation
